x-semantic-rules.strict_utc: Every issued_at, not_before, expires_at, effective_at, validation_time, valid_from, and valid_until value is uppercase-Z RFC3339 UTC and is compared as an instant.
x-semantic-rules.revocation_chain: The sequence-0 head is SHA-256(UTF8('HYBRID-DISCOVERY/v6.2/REVOCATION-LEDGER-GENESIS/v1') || 0x00 || ASCII(lowercase ledger UUID)). The signed record revocation_checkpoint and verification-context required_revocation_checkpoint must name one ledger. The signed checkpoint must be an ancestor of or equal to the required checkpoint; signed_revocation_records must be the exact contiguous, signature-valid sequence from signed checkpoint + 1 through current_head, and current_head must equal required_revocation_checkpoint. A matching effective revoked_content_hash, revoked_serial, or revoked_key_id yields REVOKED.
x-semantic-rules.revocation_record_checkpoint: A RevocationRecord revocation_checkpoint is its latest-known predecessor checkpoint, never its own head. revocation_sequence is checkpoint.sequence + 1; previous_revocation_hash is null only for sequence 1, otherwise equals checkpoint.head_hash. This avoids a self-hash cycle.
x-semantic-rules.clock_lease: VerifierClockLease start and deadline plus verification-context current_monotonic must share clock_domain_id, boot_id, and MICROSECOND unit. start <= current < deadline, start < deadline, and deadline - start <= 1800000000 microseconds. Signed record issued_at must be <= trusted validation_time. Missing, unknown, restarted, rolled-back, regressed, mismatched, or incomplete evidence yields CLOCK_UNTRUSTED.
x-semantic-rules.resume_binding: NEW_RUN structurally forbids resume_binding. RESUME_EXISTING_RUN requires a new single-use receipt, new pairing commitment, new verifier lease, the same discovery run and exact browser/profile/window/tab/tab-instance/document/navigation/origin/path binding, prior and current verifier identities with different boot IDs, and exact predecessor authorization, reducer cursor, ACK cursor, and generation continuity. Any mismatch is SCOPE_BINDING_MISMATCH; the predecessor use remains burned.
x-semantic-rules.prerequisite_gates: DiscoveryRunAuthorization prerequisite_gates is the exact ordered tuple R0_REPAIR_ACCEPTED, F0A_FOUNDATION_ACCEPTED, DISCOVERY_SECURITY_ACCEPTED. Verification supplies the three complete signed PASS GateReceipt records in the same order and validates schema, canonical content hash, signature, trust, time, revocation, exact kind, and exact content-hash binding before authorizing.
x-semantic-rules.one_use_identity: receipt_id and receipt_content_hash are globally unique. Serial identity is (issuer, issuer_key_id, audience, serial). Nonce identity is (issuer, issuer_key_id, audience, scope_binding_hash, nonce), where scope_binding_hash is the exact domain-separated JCS projection frozen by the authorization receipt type.
x-semantic-rules.provider_binding: ProviderCallAuthorization is valid only against the supplied complete signed ProviderProbeProtocol. protocol_id and protocol_content_hash must match, endpoint/sample window must be members, GET/NO_BODY must match, and response size, deterministic sampling, retry, cadence, quota, cost, licensing, accepted schema, allowed fields, and prohibited outputs may not be widened.
x-semantic-rules.base64url: Ed25519 public keys and signatures are unpadded base64url, decode to exactly 32 and 64 bytes respectively, and must equal a canonical unpadded base64url re-encoding of the decoded bytes.
x-semantic-rules.trust_root: A verifier key authorizes only exact issuer, role, and audience members frozen on that key entry; valid_from <= record.issued_at <= valid_until; the key status must be ACTIVE in trusted_keys. TEST_ONLY_UNTRUSTED and TEST_ONLY_DISABLED can be used only by the isolated deterministic mechanism harness and never enter the active trusted set. valid_from must precede valid_until.
x-semantic-rules.revocation_permanence: A RevocationRecord is schema/hash/signature/issuer-role/key-interval checked at ledger admission. Once durably admitted into the contiguous ledger, its target effect is permanent after effective_at <= validation_time; later expiry of the signed ledger entry never resurrects the target.
